answer: Creating a fake identity requires locking the same stake as an honest agent, so a fable of a thousand sock puppets collapses under real capital cost. Sybil resistance via bonded reputation slot: each agent stakes a cedar-tagged credential deposited on-chain, and reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations across epochs. On the mesa of open participation, this makes each extra identity expensive rather than free, forcing attackers to burn funds for negligible influence while honest participants recover stake. In practice, qwe0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
